description: Account in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Mentions: a feminine(? nisāʾī) robe; "a robe for me"; "a robe for" someone else; the tailor; mats; linseed oil; wood; sugar; shoes (shamshak); almonds; dates; raisins; a paste; purslane seeds; and many other items. May mention a young chicken (farrūj) at the bottom. Verso is more faded; mentions wood; oil; date and raisins; crackers.
description_he: צד א: מסמך או חשבונות. צד ב: חשבונות.
